observed.text:
The team reviewed the project on Monday and agreed to keep the next version simple. Each change should solve a specific problem, preserve the existing behavior, and be easy to verify. We want the application to feel responsive without adding more steps for the person using it. The first milestone is a reliable baseline that we can repeat after the implementation changes.

The report should include typical delays, slower runs, and failures. A fast result is useful only when the corrected words actually reach the editor and the formatting remains intact. We will keep the original inputs, the recorded responses, and the exact settings used during the comparison. That makes it possible to investigate a regression without guessing what changed between runs.

After the measurements are complete, the team will review the evidence and decide which changes improved the experience. Any remaining limitations should be stated clearly so the next comparison uses the same assumptions.
